chapter: Dancers, Newton, Chu Berry and the Cab Calloway band
title: Who arranged the Cab band's charts
summary: Dizzy, Tyree Glenn and Benny Carter charts.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Let's see, Dizzy did the chart on "Paradiddle."
Did he do many charts for the band?
That's the only one I know Dizzy did.
Apparently he also did "Pickin' the Cabbage."
"Pickin' the Cabbage" I think was his, yeah, yeah.
Who did the arrangement of "Bye Bye Blues."
I think it was Tyree Glenn.
And speaking of Benny Carter, there are a couple of Benny's charts in the book. "Lonesome Nights." And "Calling all Bars."
